description:
Mirror an iPhone to Windows over AirPlay with audio, recording, screenshots, and a presentation-ready device frame.

MirrorSim is a free, open-source Windows app that mirrors an iPhone over AirPlay in a clean device frame.
It supports live audio, iPhone volume following, automatic orientation, screenshots, screen recordings, trusted devices, diagnostics, and automatic updates.
Reliability-focused update for long-running mirroring, app and video transitions, receiver-driven orientation, built-in discovery, protected-picture guidance, and polished Console and Minimal interfaces.
